title: Tannic acid inhibits Escherichia coli biofilm formation and underlying molecular mechanisms: Biofilm regulator CsgD.
authors: Long, Jinying; Yang, Can; Liu, JingJing; Ma, Chengjun; Jiao, Min; Hu, Huiming; Xiong, Jing; Zhang, Yang; Wei, Wei; Yang, Hongzao; He, Yuzhang; Zhu, Maixun; Yu, Yuandi; Fu, Lizhi; Chen, Hongwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究单宁酸通过靶向转录因子CsgD抑制大肠杆菌生物膜形成，虽涉及TF-DNA调控机制，但核心为湿实验验证，仅用分子对接初筛，缺乏AI/物理模拟方法深度，与课题匹配度有限。
abstract: Biofilms often engender persistent infections, heightened antibiotic resistance, and the recurrence of infections. Therefor, infections related to bacterial biofilms are often chronic and pose challenges in terms of treatment. The main transcription regulatory factor, CsgD, activates csgABC-encoded curli to participate in the composition of extracellular matrix, which is an important skeleton for biofilm development in enterobacteriaceae. In our previous study, a wide range of natural bioactive compounds that exhibit strong affinity to CsgD were screened and identified via molecular docking. Tannic acid (TA) was subsequently chosen, based on its potent biofilm inhibition effect as observed in crystal violet staining. Therefore, the aim of this study was to investigate the specific effects of TA on the biofilm formation of clinically isolated Escherichia coli (E. coli). Results demonstrated a significant inhibition of E. coli Ec032 biofilm formation by TA, while not substantially affecting the biofilm of the DeltacsgD strain. Moreover, deletion of the csgD gene led to a reduction in Ec032 biofilm formation, alongside diminished bacterial motility and curli synthesis inhibition. Transcriptomic analysis and RT-qPCR revealed that TA repressed genes associated with the csg operon and other biofilm-related genes. In conclusion, our results suggest that CsgD is one of the key targets for TA to inhibit E. coli biofilm formation. This work preliminarily elucidates the molecular mechanisms of TA inhibiting E. coli biofilm formation, which could provide a lead structure for the development of future antibiofilm drugs.
abstract_zh: 生物膜常导致持续性感染、抗生素耐药性增强以及感染的复发。因此，与细菌生物膜相关的感染通常呈慢性，且治疗难度较大。主要转录调控因子CsgD激活csgABC编码的卷曲菌毛参与细胞外基质的组成，这是肠杆菌科生物膜发育的重要骨架。在我们先前的研究中，通过分子对接筛选并鉴定了一系列对CsgD具有强亲和力的天然生物活性化合物。随后，基于结晶紫染色观察到的强效生物膜抑制效果，选择了单宁酸（TA）。因此，本研究旨在探讨TA对临床分离的大肠杆菌（E. coli）生物膜形成的具体影响。结果表明，TA显著抑制了大肠杆菌Ec032的生物膜形成，而对ΔcsgD菌株的生物膜影响不大。此外，csgD基因的缺失导致Ec032生物膜形成减少，同时细菌运动性降低和卷曲菌毛合成受到抑制。转录组分析和RT-qPCR显示，TA抑制了与csg操纵子及其他生物膜相关基因的表达。总之，我们的结果表明CsgD是TA抑制大肠杆菌生物膜形成的关键靶点之一。本研究初步阐明了TA抑制大肠杆菌生物膜形成的分子机制，这可能为未来抗生物膜药物的开发提供先导结构。
